description: Merge keys into persistent task context, preserving other keys. Keep a compact current_state/next_step and retrieve history only when needed. Pass expected_version from get_task_context to guard concurrent writes. Returns a compact acknowledgment, not merged history. A conflict applies no write: read the relevant current keys, merge and retry explicitly.

context.description: Object whose keys are merged (not replaced) into existing context

expected_version.description: Optimistic concurrency guard: the context version returned by get_task_context. Omit for an unguarded merge.

source.description: Attribution source for this context write. Defaults to agent_inferred.

task_id.description: The task ID whose context to update

name: update_task_context
